passages.provision_quote: Notwithstanding any other law, commencing January 1, 2023, the division shall not approve any notice of intention under Section 3203 within a health protection zone, except for approvals of notices of intention necessary for any of the following purposes:
passages.note: Authored bill restricts new drilling only within 3,200-foot health protection zones near sensitive receptors; drilling outside those zones is unaffected, so it does not establish a statewide no-new-drilling rung.

rows.reasoning: SB 1137, which Gonzalez authored and which was signed into law, bars new drilling permits only within 3,200 feet of homes, schools, and other sensitive receptors, with exceptions; it leaves new drilling outside those zones untouched. This shows a lean against expanding drilling near sensitive communities but does not establish rung 2's clause, "Allow no new drilling," statewide, nor does it match the steady-state or expansion rungs.
needs_source: A floor statement or explanation of vote from Gonzalez tying SB 1137 to a broader statewide drilling-production position
